A refreshing, garlicky-spicy cold cucumber salad with a quick soy-sesame dressing.

## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Quantity |
|:-:|:-:|
| Persian cucumbers | 6 |
| Rice vinegar | 2 tbsp |
| Toasted sesame oil | 1 tbsp |
| Soy sauce | 1 tbsp |
| Garlic | 2 cloves, grated |
| Chili crisp | 1 tsp |

## Instructions

1. Smash the cucumbers with the flat of a knife and tear into pieces.
2. Salt them and drain in a colander for 15 minutes.
3. Whisk the remaining ingredients into a dressing.
4. Toss and serve cold.
